prompt: Which statements about gists, wikis, and GitHub Pages are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Gists share snippets, wikis document, Pages publishes. A secret gist is unlisted, not access-controlled — anyone with the URL can read it — and Pages ships a default `github.io` domain, custom domains optional.

options.text: Gists are mini-repositories for sharing snippets
Wikis hold multi-page Markdown documentation beside the code
Pages publishes a website from repository content
Secret gists are visible only to the account that created them
Pages sites can only use a custom domain
